help__about:
The version of the app and of the server, and when this version was built.
- Both numbers should be the same; if not, check for an update in Settings.
help__add_person:
Create an account for someone of the clinic.
- The username is made from the clinic code, first name and last surname; a number is added if it exists.
- Coordinators add people to their own clinic; admins choose the clinic.
- Give the person the password; they can change it in their profile.
help__clinics:
The clinics using Klyniva.
- Each clinic has a code (2-4 letters) that starts its people's usernames.
- Open a clinic for its details and people.
help__home:
Your day at a glance: what needs attention now.
- Patients waiting for a slot, referrals waiting for you and questions to answer.
- Stock running low and patients with missed sessions (coordinators).
- Click a card to go straight to the list behind it.
help__inventory:
The clinic's consumables.
- Single-use items (gloves, needles, bandages) are used and leave the stock.
- Containers (gel or oil bottles, wipes, rolls) are opened (who and when is recorded) and finished when empty.
- Items at or below the alert level are marked to order; the reorder list is ready to send.
- Per session: what every session uses, taken automatically when a session is marked as held.
- Who may change which stock depends on floor and category (People, key button).
help__new_referral:
Refer a patient to physiotherapy.
- Choose the patient, the diagnosis (ICD code helps) and the reason.
- Templates fill the usual texts for common cases.
- You can address it to a physio or leave it for the clinic to assign.
help__patient:
Everything about one patient.
- Contact, emergency contact, insurance, allergies, conditions and medication.
- Treatment plan of each open referral: what is done in each session, so a colleague can carry on.
- Consents (GDPR): what the patient agreed to, how and when.
- History: next sessions, then referrals, messages, files and sessions by month.
help__patient_form:
Register or change a patient.
- Only the name is required; NIF and SNS are checked as you type.
- Allergies, conditions and medication are lists: add a row for each.
- The form is saved on this computer while you type (24 hours) and comes back if the page closes.
- If the connection fails, nothing is lost: press Try again.
- If the patient may already exist you are shown the possible matches.
help__patients:
All the patients of your clinic.
- Search by name, NIF or SNS number.
- Filter by care level, age, gender, physio and diagnosis (clinical roles).
- The numbers above the list always match the filters, including new patients per month.
- Coordinators can export the filtered list as CSV for Excel.
- New patient registers someone; the form keeps a draft if you leave.
help__people:
The people of the clinic.
- Filter by role and by status (active, on leave, left).
- Open a person for their profile, skills and work status.
- Add person creates an account; the username follows the clinic code (cm.joao.teixeira).
- The key button sets which stock each person may change.
help__person:
A person's profile.
- Contact details and role.
- Skills (e.g. hydrotherapy) used when planning.
- Clinic and work status: active, on leave or left, with the dates.
help__referral:
One referral from start to end.
- Accept, start, complete or hand it over to another physio.
- Treatment plan: the steps of each session, in order, with time and machine.
- Messages between doctor and physio, questions and progress with pain (0-10).
- Files such as reports and images.
help__referrals:
Referrals from doctors to physiotherapy.
- Physios see their inbox: new referrals to accept and the ones they treat.
- Doctors see the referrals they wrote and how they are going.
- Filter by status, priority, physio or questions waiting for your answer.
help__settings:
Your own settings, saved on your account (they follow you to any computer).
- Theme light or dark, text size, language and how dates are shown.
- The page that opens after you sign in.
- Check for a new version of the app on this browser.
- Send a suggestion and see the answer.
help__suggestions:
Everyone's suggestions about the app, new ones first.
- Set where each one stands: read, planned, done or not planned.
- Write an answer: the person sees it in their Settings.
- The number in the menu is how many are still new.
help__time_board:
Who works where and when, and the patients of each hour.
- Day, week, month and year views; by physio or by room.
- Click a physio to see their day; drag a patient to another hour to move them.
- Waiting list: patients waiting for a slot, urgent first.
- Organizar: absences (holidays, with moving the patients), rooms, copy a day, repeat a week.
- Weekly plan books several weeks of sessions at once.

per_session_by_division_help: How many {{name}} a session uses in each division. Empty = the default ({{count}}).
per_session_example_result: So a gym session takes 1 pair of gloves; a hydrotherapy session 2 pairs and 1 cap.
per_session_explain_1: A single-use item can have a quantity used per session, e.g. 1 pair of gloves.
per_session_explain_2: When a session is marked as attended on the time board, Klyniva takes that quantity out of stock by itself: nobody has to record it.
per_session_explain_3: It can be different per division (button with the squares): e.g. 2 pairs of gloves and 1 swim cap in hydrotherapy. Divisions without their own rule use the default quantity.
per_session_explain_4: If the session goes back to booked or missed, the stock is given back.
per_session_explain_5: If there is not enough stock, the session is still recorded and the item shows as missing.
per_session_explain_6: Containers (bottles, rolls) are not used per session: they are opened and later finished.
